From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-08-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security & VPC deployment discovery - Acme Financial

Hi Aisha / John —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary from call:
- Primary objective: deploy Redwood Private in your VPC for inference with network isolation and customer-managed keys.
- Compliance drivers: SOC 2 in-scope for production, potential HIPAA-sensitive workloads in a subset of pipelines, GDPR data residency for EU customers.
- Desired topology: VPC peering or private link into our control plane, with option for air-gapped on-premise package for critical workloads.
- Timeline: target pilot in Q4, broader rollout in Q1.

Immediate asks I committed to: 
1) Share a high-level VPC deployment diagram and the options we discussed (peering, Private Link, on-prem). Attached: redwood_vpc_deployment_diagram.pdf.
2) Kick off the vendor security questionnaire (SQ). Attached template: vendor_security_questionnaire_SQ.pdf — please confirm desired scope and which team will complete it.
3) Confirm SOC 2 status and what evidence you need for your procurement; current status: Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II in-scope for our hosted control plane and can provide the SOC report under NDA.

Next steps proposed:
- Aisha: please confirm who on your security/procurement team will own the SQ and the expected date for completion.
- Acme: flag any specific HIPAA controls or documentation you require beyond SOC 2 and data processing addenda.
- Redwood: we will provide the diagram + the SQ + a short pilot runbook by end of day tomorrow.

If helpful, we can set a 30-minute follow-up with our infra/security engineer (Rishi) to walk the architecture and answer network questions.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood_vpc_deployment_diagram.pdf (application/pdf)
- vendor_security_questionnaire_SQ.pdf (application/pdf)

Marcus —

Appreciate the recap and the attachments. A few clarifying Qs from our side: 
1) SOC 2: can you confirm the period covered by your latest Type II report and whether the report covers the Private/VPC offering or only the hosted control plane? Procurement will need the report that covers any feature we rely on.
2) HIPAA: we have a subset of workloads that may be PHI-in-scope. Do you support Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and which deployment modes (hosted, dedicated, private) would be covered under a BAA?
3) Vendor SQ: happy to complete but can you confirm the expected level of detail (attestations vs. evidence) and an estimated effort — our security team will schedule time.

Also, on the diagram: can you annotate where key material (KMS/HSM) is expected to live and whether we manage keys for the Private deployment?

We'll aim to have someone from security take the SQ next week; can you share a preferred contact and an editable version of the questionnaire?

Thanks,
Aisha
Sr. Cloud Security Manager
Acme Financial

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Security & VPC deployment discovery - Acme Financial

Aisha —

Thanks for the questions; answers inline below. I've attached an editable copy of the vendor SQ and an annotated diagram showing KMS placement.

1) SOC 2: Our most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2026-09-01 through 2027-03-31. The SOC report covers our control plane and managed services; for Redwood Private deployed into customer VPCs, the report documents controls over the control plane and delivery processes. For customer-managed VPC components (customer network, key management), the customer retains responsibility for the controls. We can provide the SOC report under NDA and highlight the sections most relevant to Private deployments.

2) HIPAA/BAA: We do execute BAAs for customers with covered workloads. A BAA can be scoped to Redwood Dedicated or Private deployments; for hosted production we have a standard BAA offering. For air-gapped/on-prem installs, we can include BAA language as part of the enterprise agreement.

3) Vendor SQ: the attached questionnaire has both attestations and an evidence checklist. Expected effort for a first pass is ~2-4 hours from your security engineer to fill out answers and attach key evidence (policies, architecture diagrams, control-owner contacts). If you want, Rishi can take a call next week to walk your security engineer through questions to speed the process.

KMS/HSM: In the Private/VPC model we support two patterns:
- Customer-managed keys (recommended): customer KMS/HSM in their cloud account, Redwood references the keys via IAM roles and never has plaintext key material.
- Redwood-managed keys in a customer-dedicated HSM: Redwood manages HSM but keys are scoped to your tenant and access is restricted.

Attachments included (editable):
- vendor_security_questionnaire_SQ.pdf (editable copy)
- redwood_vpc_deployment_diagram.pdf (annotated with KMS placements)

Proposed next steps:
- Aisha: confirm who will own the SQ and the preferred date for a walkthrough (suggested: Aug 20-22).
- Acme: flag any HIPAA-specific control artifacts you need early (BAA template, specific DPIAs).
- Redwood: we will provide the SOC report via secure link once NDA is signed — Marissa will follow up on the NDA and access process.

If that all looks good I can block 30 minutes with Rishi next week to go line-by-line on the SQ.

Best,
Marcus
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- vendor_security_questionnaire_SQ.pdf (application/pdf)
- redwood_vpc_deployment_diagram.pdf (application/pdf)
